card.name: Comparisons and trade-offs of downsides
card.fires_on: Words in the middle of a contrast or trade-off, such as worse, less qualified, longer distance, or risk, where a drawback is set against a benefit. It also fires on linking words in these clauses.

modes.description: The word risk or risky in benefit-versus-risk phrasing.
modes.example: with the potential for a greater<< risk>> of adverse reactions.

modes.label: Trade-off phrasing
modes.description: Nouns or linking words completing a give-and-take statement.
modes.example: you pull with less force, but over a longer<< distance>>.
